security_implications: The chunk aggregates integrity error (intg_error) and instruction‑type violation (instr_error) into err_internal. If intg_error is not properly driven in the CmdIntgCheck path, integrity faults may go undetected, allowing corrupted data to propagate without alert. instr_error enforces that instruction accesses only succeed when en_ifetch_i is enabled; a flaw in the multi‑bit check or a false assertion could be used to deny legitimate instruction fetch or to mask an illegal access. Both paths directly impact data integrity and access control enforcement.
